description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for a GStreamer utility wrapper in the Rialto server component. It includes class declarations for a wrapper interface, a factory for creating wrapper instances, and related data structures for playback and audio attributes.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Interface class providing a method to perform audio track codec channel switching using GStreamer elements and attributes.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.

methods.name: createRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create an instance of IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.
